releases.notes:
## 📄 Alpha Change Log

Due to significant reworks behind the scenes and plans to release additional features in the near future, this release
is marked as an alpha release. Bug fixes and new features may be released rapidly and with little or no testing. **It is
recommended to backup your saves** and let us know if you experience any issues with this release!

***

**This release tests our automatic publishing system!** You may see this release appear and disappear as testing is
performed or mod details may be slightly incorrect.

Note: There is no need to update to this version at this time, so you can safely remain on older versions while testing
is performed.

***

### ⚙️ Improvements

- Updated mod dependencies on some versions.

### 🔧 Developer Changes

- Fixed Forge datagen on 1.16 to allow running all 1.16+ versions on modern Java.
- Improved some of the GitHub files, such as the code of conduct and contributing guidelines.
- Added automatic build testing to GitHub Actions, to ensure the mod at least compiles successfully.
- Added automatic publishing to GitHub Actions to improve update speed.
- Fixed data generation on 1.18 causing a bad Forgix merge.
- Removed Maven publishing references, as Maven publishing is currently not being performed.

Bug fixes and new features may be released rapidly and with little or no testing. **It is recommended to backup your saves** and let us know if you experience any issues with this release!

- Updated crossing light models (may not be visible)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **[Major]** Fixed several versions failing to render most blocks
- Fixed crafting recipes, block drops, and other block data not working properly on some versions

### 🔧 Developer Changes
- Fixed datagen creating mismatched JSON files, which causes Forgix to fail to merge the JSON files
- Fixed datagen not working for recipes on Forge 1.20
- Updated version to 0.7.0-alpha.1
- Made other datagen system improvements related to fixing the mismatching JSON files

releases.notes:
**This version has known issues! It is NOT recommended to install it!**

### 🎉 New Features!
- New one-sided railroad crossing light!

### ⚙️ Improvements
- Significantly improved block visuals while in inventory, hand, item frames, or on the ground!
- Updated block collision shapes
- Improved some crafting recipes
- Made more blocks appear together in the crafting recipes menu
- Added blocks to appropriate crafting recipes categories on modern versions

### 🌐 Translations
- Updated most translations to support the new railroad crossing light block

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue with missing particles on some blocks
- Fixed some blocks having weird particle effects
- Fixed several inconsistencies across mod versions
- Crafting recipes should now appear in crafting menus when the correct conditions are met (usually after crafting an item for the first time)

### ❓ Other Changes
- Removed NeoForge support on 1.20.x to simplify mod development and data gen. Note: NeoForge will continue to be supported on 1.21+.

### 🔧 Developer Changes
- Added datagen to most versions (All mod loaders on 1.18+ and Forge on 1.16.x)
- Removed test block models and test block textures
- Redid blockstates and collision shapes for several blocks
- Removed old JSON files made obsolete by datagen
- Updated internal iron pole texture
- Updated version to 0.7.0-alpha
- Made code more consistent
- Improved JavaDoc in some areas
- Added more warning suppressions where appropriate
